previewDeathNotice.description:
Peacefully at his niece Lena's residence.

Deeply missed by his loving family nieces Catherine, Lena, Mellissa and Mary, nephew Philip, grandnieces, grandnephews, great-grandnieces, great-grandnephew, Noel and Deirdre Mc Carthy, his friends in Obair, relatives, neighbours.

 

May he Rest In Peace.

 

In accordance with current government guidelines a private Funeral Mass for family and friends will be celebrated in Our Lady of The Rosary Church, Newmarke-on-Fergus this Monday (5th October) at 12 noon followed by burial afterwards in Lemenagh Cemetery Newmarket-on-Fergus.

Family flowers only, donations, if desired, to Milford Care Centre.

Mass cards and letters of sympathy can be sent to Mc Mahon Funeral Directors.

If you would like to write a condolence please do so on the link below.
